Task 7  
 
Task Title:  
 Build a Multi -Agent AI System for Report Generation  
 Task Description :  
In this task, you will build a multi -agent AI system where multiple agents collaborate 
to generate a structured report from a user question . Instead of using one  LLM, you 
must create multiple agents, where each agent has a specific role.  The agents must 
work together to complete the task step by step.  
Task Objective :  
You must build a system with at least 4 agents:  
 Planner Agent  
 Research Agent  
 Writer Agent  
 Summary  Agent  
 (Optional) Evaluator Agent  
The system should take a user question and generate a final report using collaboration 
between agents .
